description: Combined PRD evidence from two isolated Codex/Ralph stream worktrees. Verification and PR gate run on this integration branch.

userStories.title: MCP ObjectType Resource Misses Use Application Errors
userStories.story: As an MCP client reading a previously listed ObjectType resource, I want stale ontology or ObjectType URIs to return a resource-not-found application error instead of an invalid-params error, so that malformed URI handling stays distinct from catalog drift and retry/error UI can classify the failure correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a well-formed `weave://objecttype/<ontologyApiName>/<objectTypeApiName>` URI whose ObjectType no longer exists, when `resources/read` is called, then the JSON-RPC error code is `CodeToolError` and the message mentions the missing object type.

Given a well-formed `weave://objecttype/<ontologyApiName>/<objectTypeApiName>` URI whose ontology no longer exists, when `resources/read` is called, then the JSON-RPC error code is `CodeToolError` and the message mentions the ontology lookup.
Given a malformed ObjectType resource URI missing the ObjectType segment, when `resources/read` is called, then the JSON-RPC error code remains `CodeInvalidParams`.
bdd: Given a stale ObjectType resource URI, when the MCP client reads it, then Weave reports an application resource miss.
Given a malformed ObjectType resource URI, when the MCP client reads it, then Weave reports invalid params.

userStories.title: CI Discovers Full Playwright BDD Suite
userStories.story: As a Weave maintainer, I want the web CI list-only Playwright gate to discover the full BDD suite under web/tests so syntax and import regressions in browser dogfood specs are caught before full E2E runs.
acceptanceCriteria: Given checked-in Playwright BDD specs live under web/tests, when CI runs the Playwright spec discovery command, then the command includes the web/tests suite root rather than only a few sampled BDD files.
Given the workflow is edited, when the contract test reads .github/workflows/ci.yml, then it fails if the discovery step omits tests/ from its target list.
Given a local developer needs to verify discovery, when they read web/tests/README.md, then it documents the list-only CI discovery command for the BDD suite.

bddScenarios.given: the repository contains multiple web/tests/feature.*.spec.ts browser BDD specs
bddScenarios.when: the CI Playwright spec discovery step is inspected
bddScenarios.then: it includes tests/ so every BDD spec is parsed in list-only mode

dependencies: web/playwright.config.ts includes web/tests/**/*.spec.ts in normal Playwright discovery
CI web job runs from the web/ working directory
